ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool tracking industrial runoff and water quality changes specifically for Delaware local waterways using spatial imagery analysis.
ideas.title: Delaware Local Watershed AI Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying geospatial AI to localized industrial and environmental compliance, which appeals strongly to regional university judges.

ideas.pitch: A predictive model and dashboard estimating campus safety incidents and maintenance bottlenecks using Poisson regression and historical university facilities data.
ideas.title: Campus AI Incident Forecasting Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the technical win condition of the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon by using robust statistical modeling like Poisson regression instead of a generic wrapper.

ideas.pitch: A personalized meal planning and campus dining nutrition assistant utilizing LangGraph and RAG to optimize meals based on local student dining hall menus.
ideas.title: Student Health and Nutrition Multi-Agent Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon the success of E-Foodiee and Greennovation by integrating multi-agent student workflows with practical, highly personalized health recommendations.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent marketplace facilitating secure, escrow-backed transactions between student freelancers and local Newark businesses using USDC.
ideas.title: Local Vendor Micro-Escrow Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the proven Dispatch architecture combining autonomous agents with real financial settlement, creating a tangible product with immediate local utility.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient intake and trust acquisition platform tailored for regional dental and health clinics around Delaware to streamline patient onboarding.
ideas.title: Prosthodontic Patient Trust Engine for Regional Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the exact winning strategy of Global-Smile by focusing on vertical-specific patient acquisition and trust-building workflows.
